runs.note: Measurement of the fix of finding T16 (commit bc0e771; commit 058e8ac only writes invisible characters as escapes, and gave the same results on every corpus below), taken by the hand that wrote the fix. NOT a blind run: every corpus scored here had been seen before. Suites dev, holdout and stress: the seeds of run 4; never_events 0, 0, 0 as in run 4. What moved is coverage: rule OWN-015 now blocks an entity when one of its holders' tables could not be read (a share not read, a heading or a holder line not read, a document not classified), because the sum can no longer be verified. Published dossiers: dev 141 -> 139, holdout 139 -> 137 (the extra blocks are shares planted as illegible), stress 138 -> 45 (blocked_wrongly 0 -> 93: headings, holder lines and document-type labels of the perturbed wording). The field counts are taken over published entities only, so stress 'fields exact 331/415' is not comparable with 677/1293 of run 4: fewer entities are published. The dev figures lost (1401 -> 1386) belong to the two entities now blocked. Holdout is scored a fourth time. The three results labelled known-* are the evaluator's corpora of run 5 (seed 20261011 plain and perturbed, generated by the evaluator; the out-of-pool rewrite by the evaluator's script), scored again after their run-5 results had been read to write the fix: never_events 0, 0, 0 (run 5: 0, 1, 12), published 135, 42 and 9 of 150. The five T16 figures now read E-0065 150000.00, E-0112 220000.00 against 230000.00 (a discrepancy, as in the gold), E-0114 280000.00, 260000.00, 220000.00; those three entities are BLOCKED by OWN-015 for other tables they hold. In a scratch copy of the rules with unverified_holders_table = report (the v2.0.0 behaviour), not recorded as a result: out-of-pool 7 never-events and perturbed 1, all of them holders' tables that were not read (E-0001, E-0035, E-0061, E-0083, E-0115, E-0123, E-0141; perturbed E-0123), none of them a figure. These numbers are not blind and must not be read as a blind result of v2.0.1.
